source_units.text: I have a tooth-identification worksheet for an anatomy class.
Use the exact labels "Incisors", "Premolars", "Molars" in the schedule, with at least 25 total minutes assigned to each.
Within that coverage, "Incisors" needs at least 35 total minutes.
There is a firm ceiling of 70 study minutes on each date.
The last usable study date is 2027-02-07, and sessions may fall on that day.
